name: rtx3090-r5-native-v1-candidate
description: r5 = layer-selective INT8 stagewise UNet srcg50 (gmac_0.50 recipe) bs16 + TensorRT TAESD bs8, built natively for exactly an RTX 3090 (sm_86, no hardware-compatibility mode). Same recipe, precision and checkpoint as ampere-plus-r5-srcg50-int8, without its ~30% hardware-compat kernel penalty. Measured on RTX 3090s, same host, 6-stream full recipe: 399 vs 278 FPS (Ryzen 9 5900X, 350 W) and 381.9 vs 266.8 FPS (i7-12700K, 300 W). Quality on the same 3090 (2026-10-19, hc-e): UNet vs eager FP16 mae_max 0.00471 vs 0.00470 (portable), max_abs 0.612 vs 0.735; TAESD mean 0.0676 vs 0.0675 LSB (max 7 vs 5); identical gate outcomes on all six identities; native vs portable frames SSIM face 0.9995-0.9997, mouth 0.9982-0.9986, lip-sync r 0.9996-0.9998. The older frozen 236/698 parity bound compares against a 4070-family reference and is not a quality regression versus portable.
